_scenario_metadata.scenario_name: Tehri Dam — Hypothetical Worst-Case Overtopping Breach (Baseline)
_scenario_metadata.scenario_classification: HYPOTHETICAL EMERGENCY PLANNING SCENARIO — NOT A FORECAST
notes: All SCENARIO ASSUMPTION parameters are explicitly labelled as such.
No scenario assumption may be silently upgraded to AUTHORITATIVE status.
Active breach volume 600 MCM = 16.9% of total 3540 MCM reservoir capacity.
Froehlich (2008) breach formation time: tf = 0.0179 * Vw^0.364 * hb^-0.564.
Conservative factor 0.90 applied to Froehlich tf per Phase 4 methodology.
Tehri is an earth-and-rockfill embankment dam: trapezoidal breach side slope z=1.0.
Manning n values from Chow (1959) — steep confined Bhagirathi gorge — SCENARIO ASSUMPTION.

initial_water_level_m.source: THDC Full Reservoir Level (FRL) = 830.0 m MSL

total_capacity_mcm.source: THDC India Limited; CWC (gross storage 3.54 km³)

active_breach_volume_mcm.source: Phase 5 engineering judgment — 16.9% of total capacity. NOT MEASURED.

breach_formulation.value: Froehlich (2008) overtopping + broad-crested weir release + strict mass conservation
breach_formulation.source: Froehlich, D.C. (2008). Predicting Peak Discharge from Gradually Breached Embankment Dams. J. Hydrologic Engrg. ASCE.

breach_depth_m.source: Dam height = breach depth for full overtopping failure. THDC (260.5 m).
breach_depth_m.notes: For embankment dam: complete overtopping failure assumed for worst case

breach_bottom_width_m.source: Froehlich (2008): Wb = 0.1803 * Ko * Vw^0.32 * Hb^0.19; Ko=1.0 (overtopping); Vw=6e8 m³; Hb=260.5 m → Wb≈334 m.
breach_bottom_width_m.reason_for_rounding: Rounded to 335 m; remains below crest length (575 m)

breach_side_slope_z.source: Von Thun and Gillette (1990); NWS BREACH default for embankment dams
breach_side_slope_z.notes: Earth-and-rockfill dam fails trapezoidally (z=1.0), unlike near-vertical masonry gravity failure

breach_formation_time_hr.reason_for_factor: 0.90× conservative factor per Phase 4 approved methodology: faster breach produces higher peak discharge, more conservative for emergency planning
breach_formation_time_hr.notes: Explicitly classified SCENARIO ASSUMPTION. Not a measured value.

weir_coefficient_rectangular.source: Chaudhry (2008) broad-crested weir; USACE HEC-RAS default

timestep_sec.notes: Baseline dt=60 s. Sensitivity: also run at 30 s and 15 s.

simulation_duration_hr.notes: 8 hr captures the flood wave through the steep Bhagirathi gorge and recession

inundation_threshold_m.source: Standard European Flood Directive minimum inundation threshold (JRC, 2017)

main_channel.source: Chow (1959) Table 5-6 — steep mountain stream, cobbles and large boulders (Bhagirathi gorge).

floodplain.source: Chow (1959) — steep valley sides with brush and trees

study_domain.note: Study domain covers Tehri Dam (30.3783N 78.48E) and the downstream Bhagirathi gorge
